ancient.title: Ancient
ancient.description:
The Ancient is a vaguely humanoid creature, though it's much larger than a Human. It has ribbed appendages which nearly extend the full length of their bodies.
When first meeting an Ancient, it talks to the crew using what appears to be some form of telepathy. It speaks in riddles and seems to have the ability to cause harm to the crew (as hinted in one of the dialogue options).

fractalguardian2.title: Ancient Weapon Fractal Guardian
fractalguardian2.description: The Ancient Weapon Fractal Guardian is a mechanical entity which roams the hallways of Alien Ruins. It is capable of opening ruin doors, and navigates the ruins with ease.

molochblack.title: Black Moloch
molochblack.description: The Black Moloch, as the name suggests, is a black variant of the Moloch. Its darker shell makes it harder to see, though the dull greenish glow of the Black Moloch's core tends to reveal its location. Black Molochs are a significantly greater threat compared to the Moloch, and caution is advised when encountering one.

bonethresher.title: Bone Thresher
bonethresher.description: Bone Threshers are moray-like creatures with a rough, heavily armored body, a gaping maw and two small lateral fins. Their body is heavily protected by large plates of bone-like armor (giving it the Bone Thresher name). Like their smaller relatives, Bone Threshers have no visible eyes and a jaw filled with many razor-sharp teeth.

charybdis.title: Charybdis
charybdis.description: The Charybdis body appears as a large mass of dark tentacles serving for navigation, and ending with a sharp point, reminiscent of a spear tip. Its teeth and massive tongue are crimson red.

crawler.title: Crawler
crawler.description: Crawlers are relatively small and agile, and are one of the few creatures capable of entering the Submarine. They possess four pairs of red eyes, green skin, segmented spines on their back and multiple hand-like appendages, with only the frontal ones having a functionality, allowing them to latch on surfaces, swim and crawl (hence their name).

crawlerbroodmother.title: Crawler Broodmother
crawlerbroodmother.description: The Crawler Broodmother is a large beast which hunts surrounded by Crawlers. It is significantly larger than a Crawler, but its behavior remains similar. It has several eyes, crown-like protrusions on its head, and a large stomach; presumably where the Crawler Eggs are stored for its ranged attack. A Crawler Broodmother will attack its target using its jaw, preferring to continue swimming past its prey. A blow to the skull of a Human can be fatal.

crawler_hatchling.title: Crawler Hatchling
crawler_hatchling.description: The Crawler Hatchling is significantly smaller than the Crawler. Its skin is underdeveloped, still being covered in blood and the gooey insides of the egg. Their teeth and claws are softer than the typical Crawler, as they have yet to harden with age. Despite their stature, they are still a threat to those around them, especially if their prey underestimates its ability.

petcthulhu.title: Cthulhu
petcthulhu.description: The Cthulhu possesses an octopus-like head whose face is a mass of feelers, though its body is of a dragon with a pair of wings and a tail. This is the only Pet that floats by flapping its wings instead of undulating along the ground like other Pets' sluggish movement.

cyborgworm.title: Cyborg Worm
cyborgworm.description: The Cyborg Worm appears to be a large Endworm with parts of it shell replaced by alien materials and its mandibles replaced by alien turrets. It's also considerably shorter than a normal Endworm, possibly implying that a part of its tail has been cut off. The alien augmentations, and the fact that it resides in the fortress built by the Ancients to house Jove on Jupiter, implies it might be an Endworm modified and enslaved by the Ancients to serve as their "watchdog".

defensebot.title: Defense Bot
defensebot.description:
The Defense Bot is a small robotic creature which can hover above the ground or swim through water using two propellers. It has a sensor which allows it to perceive the outside world along with any threats that challenge it. Whilst fragile in nature, it can defend itself and friendly creatures using its mounted gun which fires 10 bullets per second.
Unlike other pets, the Defense Bot does not require food nor does it produce any items.
To craft the Defense Bot, it requires 1x  FPGA Circuit, 1x  SMG, and 2x  Titanium-Aluminum Alloy at a  Fabricator.
Upon creation of the Defense Bot, it will immediately appear as a creature instead of an item.

endworm.title: Endworm
endworm.description:
The Endworm itself is a colossal behemoth, a serpent-like leviathan covered in an incredibly durable, stone-like armor shell.
It is incredibly fast, aggressive, and durable enough to withstand nuclear ordnance, but still has certain vulnerabilities.
Its presence is often preluded by its constant monstrous roaring, which is often visible on a submarine's sonar due to its intensity.

fractalguardian.title: Fractal Guardian
fractalguardian.description: The Fractal Guardian is a mechanical entity which roams the hallways of Alien Ruins. It is capable of opening ruin doors, and navigates the ruins with ease. It possesses two weapons: a blade-like spear which can be shot at intruders, Human or otherwise; and a "hook cannon" (comparable to the  Harpoon Gun). It is incredibly aggressive towards anything aside from  Husks,  Swarm Feeders and other Ruin Guardians. It is much larger than a person and is completely capable of besting one in combat if they catch them unaware.

giantspineling.title: Giant Spineling
giantspineling.description: The Giant Spineling is significantly larger than the Spineling. Despite its size, however, it remains just as nimble as its smaller counterpart. The Giant Spineling is covered in a green moss-like substance and has drastically less spikes around its body. Its tail-end is shaped like a flipper, which perhaps is the source of its speed relative to its size, as such a flipper is absent on regular Spinelings.

hammerheadgold.title: Golden Hammerhead
hammerheadgold.description: Golden Hammerheads are tougher variants of the Hammerhead. They possess a hardened blunt head strong enough to punch holes in hulls, and also feature the Hammerhead trademark; four scythe-like limbs, each of which can inflict very heavy Bleeding on any living creature, with 360° of reach. As its name implies, the Golden Hammerhead has gold-colored, somewhat shiny skin, and two motionless fins to act as stabilizers.

guardianrepairbot.title: Guardian Repair Bot
guardianrepairbot.description: The Guardian Repair Bot appears from EMP Fractal Guardians and Portal Guardians once their health drops below certain thresholds. They circle around the Guardian whilst healing it.

hammerhead.title: Hammerhead
hammerhead.description: Hammerheads are medium-size shark-like creatures. They have at least two pairs of eyes, four claws, four fins, and a long tail, which is their primary mode of locomotion.

hammerheadmatriarch.title: Hammerhead Matriarch
hammerheadmatriarch.description: The Hammerhead Matriarch is a large, dark red squid-like creature with four arms attached to its torso. Despite the sharp appearance of these arms, the Hammerhead Matriarch is a docile creature. It avoids combat wherever possible, only responding aggressively when provoked. Its head is a large, fragile sac of eggs.

hammerheadspawn.title: Hammerhead Spawn
hammerheadspawn.description: The Hammerhead Spawn hatches from eggs inside the head of the Hammerhead Matriarch upon death. They have the shape of a standard Hammerhead, only much smaller. They share the Matriarch's dark-red shade. Their eyes are particularly large compared with the rest of their body and many features of the Hammerhead have yet to develop.

husk.title: Husk
husk.description: Husks take on the form of Human divers which have become infected and taken over by an instance of Velonaceps Calyx. Their appearance is equivalent to that of a regular crew member wearing a rusted orange Diving Suit, with the biggest difference being three small stingers protruding out of their broken helmets.

huskchimera.title: Husk Chimera
huskchimera.description: Chimeras appear as grosteque huskified fusions of a Human, Mantis, and Spineling. Their human head has 6 ovipositors, and the rest of their body is partially protected by separated pieces of a rusted diving suit. They have several mantis legs and claws, which are used for attacks. The back of a Chimera is lined with 8 protruding spines. Their limbs and spines have the same color as their ovipositors, which is similar to that of dried blood.

huskexosuit.title: Husk Exosuit
huskexosuit.description:
The Husk Exosuit, as the name suggests, wears an Exosuit instead of a normal diving suit. This makes it slower but considerably more difficult to kill than a regular Husk.
It can easily be distinguished from a player wearing an Exosuit by the rusty look of said suit, as well as the fleshy tendrils coming out from the broken glass.

huskprowler.title: Husk Prowler
huskprowler.description: The Husk Prowler moves faster than you’d like it to and employs leaping attacks. Generally the best way to avoid husk infections is to keep your distance, but with this one, that might be difficult.

crawlerhusk.title: Husked Crawler
crawlerhusk.description:
Husked Crawlers are slower than their normal counterparts, however they possess the dangerous ability to inflict the husk infection to their victims.
They look almost identical to normal crawlers, however their skin appears rotten and faded. Three stingers poke out of their mouth.
They hunt in significantly larger packs compared to regular Crawlers, and are considerably larger threats.

huskcontainer.title: Huskified Storage Container
huskcontainer.description: The Huskified Storage Container is a Husk Parasite confined within a Storage Container. It has three appendages which protrude out the front of the Storage Container which it uses to move itself around and attack creatures.

jove.title: Jove
jove.description: Jove is the final boss of Barotrauma that was introduced in 1.0.7.0. An ancient god-like creature found in the Eye of Europa, it is worshipped by Ancients. It has a shield that blocks projectiles and all damage, and pylons must be destroyed to disable the shield.  Ancients refer to Jove as YOH-WEY.

latcher.title: Latcher
latcher.description: The Latcher is a large creature which resides in the Abyss. It has several eyes which glow, revealing its position to anyone gazing through windows or a periscope. Its many teeth are used to consume smaller living beings, though it has been observed to feast on corpses lost to the depths. It has four legs which make its signature on the sonar easy to identify. Within the mouth of this creature hides an incredibly long tongue which can extend up to 45 meters. Once the tongue makes contact with a target, the Latcher will only let go if it feels threatened, wishes to attack from a new angle, or has eaten whatever it has caught.

leucocyte.title: Leucocyte
leucocyte.description: Leucocytes are small, agile, and are capable of entering a Submarine. They resemble a sort of green algae in a spherical shape. They move around by pushing towards a particular direction. Leucocytes are very capable of killing Humans by inflicting  Acid Burn  and  Slow Paralysis. Leucocytes appear everywhere within wrecked hulls of submarines, often in groups.

mantis.title: Mantis
mantis.description: The shrimp-like Mantis was believed to have been hunted to extinction by Europan colonists, but recently a new, venomous subspecies was discovered. The cave-dwelling Mantises are known to change the colors of their shells, making them very effective at camouflaging themselves on cave walls, which most likely gave them an advantage over their bright-orange cousins.

moloch.title: Moloch
moloch.description:
Molochs' large dark blue shells cover most of their main bodies, also known as their "core", to provide protection from their front. Moloch's cores are mostly made up of their "ballast sac", which pulsates to allow movement underwater.
Above the Moloch's core, three elongated dark brown tentacles protrude from under the shell. Below the core, thin black tendrils known as the "skirt" trail the Moloch, providing extra protection.
Molochs rely on echolocation to navigate. The sounds emitted from this are strikingly tuneful notes, which become stronger and higher in tone when the creature attacks. These will also cause interference on Sonar if they are close enough, and leads to Moloch being detected from a relatively long range in passive sonar, compared to other Creatures.

molochbaby.title: Moloch Baby
molochbaby.description: The Moloch Baby is a small, pink jellyfish-like creature that slowly floats around the oceans of Europa. It is one of the few passive creatures in the game, being completely unable to attack Humans and lacking any defensive resistances. The Moloch Baby has the ability to send out loud screeches if it feels threatened, which alert any nearby Molochs of an enemy's presence.

mopingjack.title: Moping Jack
mopingjack.description: Moping Jack is capable of inflicting considerable damage to the outer walls of a Submarine, utilizing its flat head to bash holes in a given surface. It will relentlessly pound at the outer hull of the submarine and its occupants, being capable of stopping a fast moving sub dead in its tracks.

mudraptor.title: Mudraptor
mudraptor.description: Mudraptors are agile creatures and are one of the few creatures capable of entering the Submarine. Mudraptors possess two strong legs which allow them to walk in a bipedal posture, and an extremely sharp beak capable of breaching a Submarine's hulls. They can easily kill Humans by mauling them to death. They have teal skin covered by many grey shells and tiny, almost vestigial hand-like appendages.

mudraptor_hatchling.title: Mudraptor Hatchling
mudraptor_hatchling.description: The Mudraptor Hatchling is significantly smaller than the Mudraptor. Its skin is underdeveloped, still being covered in blood and the gooey insides of the egg. Their beaks haven't developed at all, their claws are softer than the typical Mudraptor, and they lack the armor that develops with age. Despite their stature, they are still a threat to those around them, especially if their prey underestimates its ability.

mudraptor_unarmored.title: Mudraptor Unarmored
mudraptor_unarmored.description: Mudraptors are agile creatures and are one of the few creatures capable of entering the Submarine. Mudraptors possess two strong legs which allow them to walk in a bipedal posture, and an extremely sharp beak capable of breaching a Submarine's hulls. They can easily kill Humans by mauling them to death. Usually they have teal skin covered by many grey shells and tiny, almost vestigial hand-like appendages. The Unarmored Mudraptor variant lacks any armor, leaving it much more vulnerable.

mudraptor_veteran.title: Mudraptor Veteran
mudraptor_veteran.description: The Mudraptor Veteran is a larger, older Mudraptor. Its armor resembles rusted metal, and its claws are capable of easily shredding through any wall or Door. The age of the Mudraptor Veteran has caused its shell to grow sharper and more defined. However, its armor is not any stronger than a regular Mudraptor's.

petraptor.title: Orange Boy
petraptor.description: The Orange Boy appears to be some type of crustacean with big flaps for limbs. As the name suggests, the Orange Boy's shell is a bright orange color with yellow beige skin underneath.

petsmallcrawler.title: Peanut
petsmallcrawler.description: The Peanut appears to be some sort of a small sized slug with a big oval head and a mediocre shell on its back, providing no protection.

mudraptor_pet.title: Petraptor
mudraptor_pet.description:
The Petraptor is a friendly Mudraptor which is 70% the size of an adult Mudraptor. It's distinctly darker than typical Mudraptors and has deep purple colored flesh. Despite its age and size, the Petraptor is still a threat to Europan life.
The Petraptor can be spawned by giving Saline to a Petraptor Egg and waiting for it to grow. Interestingly, the Petraptor Egg must be placed on the ground in front of the Medical Fabricator that created it. It cannot be moved to another location without growing it first.

psilotoad.title: Psilotoad
psilotoad.description: The Psilotoad has a face and skin tone similar to that of a toad, however its body is more of a slug. On its back grows some kind of fungus, which forms into a shell of sorts. It also has a transparent tadpole-like tail from behind.

spineling.title: Spineling
spineling.description: The Spineling is small and spindly, appearing similar to a dark dragonfly thanks to its twelve metallic-white spines and scales on its rear, but is more so a fin-less eel, capable of twisting on the spot to get the best shot with its plethora of natural harpoons.

fractalguardian3.title: Steam Cannon Fractal Guardian
fractalguardian3.description: The Steam Cannon Fractal Guardian is a mechanical entity which roams the hallways of Alien Ruins. It is capable of opening ruin doors, and navigates the ruins with ease. It possesses two weapons: a blade-like spear which can be shot at intruders, Human or otherwise; and a steam cannon (similar to the  Prototype Steam Cannon). It is incredibly aggressive towards anything aside from  Husks,  Swarm Feeders and other Ruin Guardians. It is much larger than a person and is completely capable of besting one in combat if they catch them unaware.

swarmfeeder.title: Swarm Feeder
swarmfeeder.description: The Swarm Feeder is an incredibly small critter. Despite its size, it is still a threat to consider when exploring Alien Ruins, especially when entering rooms without caution. The Swarm Feeder sustains itself off fresh blood, preferably sourced from an unsuspecting diver.

terminalcell.title: Terminal Cell
terminalcell.description: Terminal cells are incredibly small and share many of the traits associated with the Leucocyte. They have the unique ability that causes them to detonate when killed, creating a high intensity of flash, hull damage, and Acid Burns. Terminal Cells are considered to be the aggressor agent to a Thalamus, as they are exclusively used to attack foreign objects that may threaten the Thalamus. This is in contrast to the Leucocyte, which is considered to be the defender agent.

tigerthresher.title: Tiger Thresher
tigerthresher.description: Tiger Threshers are eel-like creatures that have leopard-like splotches towards the front of their body, and small stripes towards their tail (like a tiger). Their head is transparent and bioluminescent, like that of a barreleye fish. Like the head of the Tiger Thresher, their tail also glows, but not as brightly as their head. The spine of the Tiger Thresher has spiny protrusions that cover the majority of their back. Tiger Threshers do not have visible eyes, like most of the sea-life on Europa.

tigerthresher_hatchling.title: Tiger Thresher Hatchling
tigerthresher_hatchling.description: The Tiger Thresher Hatchling is significantly smaller than the Tiger Thresher. Its skin is underdeveloped, still being covered in blood and the gooey insides of the egg. Its teeth haven't come through yet and the distinctive tiger stripes are absent from the body. Despite their stature, they are still a threat to those around them, especially if their prey underestimates its ability.

watcher.title: Watcher
watcher.description:
The Watcher consists of a jet-black main body of immense size that takes the shape of a sphere, and is surrounded by thick armor and protective spikes, giving it great resistance to almost all forms of damage, but this is balanced by its large, vulnerable eye. Named after said ominous red eye, the Watcher lacks any true method of attack, but does inflict many negative effects in the form of  Watcher's Gaze when investigating Submarines or Divers.
Watchers are completely deaf, and rely entirely on their impressive sight to find objects of interest such as submarines or divers.
Watchers are solitary and never found with one of its own. Watchers do not interact with other Watchers. However, they do tend to gather crowds of other creatures, such as Crawlers or Mudraptors.
